flow.name: 07 · Loop · foreach line of webhook body
flow.notes: Webhook → loop once per non-empty line of the body → post each line as a separate notification with its index. Tests Loop in FOREACH_LINES mode, item/index variable bindings, and webhook.body magic text. Trigger from a shell once enabled: curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8821/hook/loop --data-binary $'alpha\nbeta\ngamma'. Expect 3 notifications labeled 0/1/2.
